subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Mosquitoes ______ if there is no water logging.
solution:
The correct answer is "will not breed."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Using **"will not breed"** in the blank indicates a future condition that prevents the breeding of mosquitoes.
 
• The phrase **"will not breed"** is appropriate in the blank of the sentence because it conveys a future condition or outcome.
 
• The phrase** "will not"** suggests a negative outcome in the absence of water logging, emphasizing the dependence of mosquito breeding on the presence of stagnant water.
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 3.

**Correct sentence**: *Mosquitoes **will not breed**__ if there is no water logging.*
